name: Swift Crafting
body:
You can craft items both mundane and magical faster than most.

Prerequisite: Craft 5 ranks or any item creation feat

Benefit: It takes you half as long to make non-magical items using Craft skills, and you treat magic items as being 20% cheaper for the purpose of determining how long it will take to create. This reduction does not stack with any other reduction in crafting time from class features, such as a vanguard’s rapid construction ability.
